drafts.name: Physically verify specifications before installation — never trust labels alone
drafts.description: Before installing any hardware, physically confirm the critical specification (length, diameter, fit, etc.) with direct measurement or observation. Label misprints and mislabeled stock are known failure modes; a ruler or caliper is the ground truth.

drafts.name: Preserve existing integrity — never modify pristine components or remove safeguards
drafts.description: Components in a pristine state and existing mandatory safeguards must be left untouched. The burden of proof for any modification is extremely high; when in doubt, preserve rather than alter.

drafts.name: Always trace every decision to a named authoritative artifact
drafts.description: Every specification, part selection, or procedural choice must be anchored to a specifically named, official artifact (sketch revision, batch ID, manifest, etc.). Improvising from memory, using unlabeled defaults, or citing secondary sources is not acceptable.
